## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

Basic design defines the visual language of books, magazines, and reports. It
ranges from clean minimalism to ornate, expressive, or retro aesthetics.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, editorial
- Typography scale: desktop-first expressive scale | Fonts: primary=Nunito,
  display=Oswald, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600,
  700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#A855F7, secondary=#0A1829, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#0A1829
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, professional.

## Design intent

Print-inspired visual language for books, magazines, and reports with editorial
grids and expressive typography.
